description: Request an AS-REP for an account with Kerberos pre-authentication disabled and crack it offline to recover the password.

telemetry.detail: Kerberos AS-REQ / TGT request without pre-authentication for the target account; the encrypted AS-REP is the crackable material.
Kerberos pre-authentication activity; enumerating DONT_REQ_PREAUTH accounts precedes the roast.

WDAC / App Control blocks the unsigned Rubeus / other .NET roasting tools binary on-host (enforce 3077; audit-only logs 3076). Evaded by native LOLBin or remote (Impacket) execution - see the tooling axis.

prerequisite_privilege: None for the request against a pre-auth-disabled account; enumeration needs a domain user
notes: Only works against accounts with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH set (a misconfiguration). Quiet by default; cracking is offline. The pre-auth-disabled state is itself the finding.
